issue.title: bob highlights clip: --mode page, image rescue for dropped figures, and --keep-source DIR

task_type_fields.proposal:
Extend `bob highlights clip` beyond reader mode (proposed by phase bob-cli-35.5 of epic bob-cli-35, recorded by bob-cli-35.land):

- `--mode page`: print the live page (facsimile) instead of re-typesetting the Defuddle extraction with the Bob reader template, for pages where reader mode loses layout that matters.
- Image rescue: when the adapter's fidelity check warns "page showed N large images below the title; extraction kept M", recover the dropped figures from the cleaned snapshot and insert them rather than only warning.
- `--keep-source DIR`: keep the captured source (cleaned snapshot HTML, article.json, localized assets) in a caller-chosen directory for debugging or archiving, beyond today's `BOB_WEB_CLIP_KEEP_WORKDIR=1` scratch-dir retention.

Relevant code: scripts/web_clip/web_clip_adapter.py (fidelity verdict, image localization), scripts/web_clip/web_clip_render.py, src/native/highlights_ref/clip.rs; contract in docs/highlights-clip.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202610/web_url_highlights_clip.md declares "Reader mode only in v1" and lists `--mode page`, `--keep-source`, and image rescue under "Out of scope". Epic bob-cli-35 shipped reader mode with fail-closed/warn fidelity checks as designed; these are new capabilities, not defects in it.

issue.creation_reason: Epic bob-cli-35's live-verify phase proposed page mode, image rescue, and source retention as follow-ups; the epic plan explicitly kept v1 to reader mode and excluded these flags.
